items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: I think Mamie Smith is the first real popular blues singer, Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: Of these, did you hear any of the big famous blues singers when you're down here, people like Ma Rainey or Bessie Smith?

Oh, yeah, I worked with Ma Rainey, like we played what you call day and date, you know. I was sure maybe, I was sure in one theater, her show in another theater like that, you know, see. Sure, I heard Ma Rainey, in fact, I heard them all, Bessie Smith, Clara Smith, Mamie Smith, you know. Who of them did you like the best? Well, when I first heard the first record of Mamie Smith, the Crazy Blues, I liked it fine, you know. Yeah, and I liked her style, I liked her way of singing. That was the first blues record in…
Well, who were some of the singers around town that were prominent on the order of Ma Rainey? You mean here in New Orleans? In New Orleans, did you hear her?
